description: This Java class 'MidiPrinter' provides methods for formatting and printing MIDI messages and device information, including mapping MIDI status bytes to human-readable names, formatting byte arrays, and extracting device properties.

classes.name: MidiPrinter
classes.description: A utility class for formatting MIDI messages and device info for printing.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable name for a MIDI status byte, distinguishing between system and channel commands.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Formats a byte array into a string of hexadecimal values.

methods.name: formatMessage
methods.description: Formats a MIDI message byte array into a human-readable string, including message type and data.

methods.name: formatDeviceInfo
methods.description: Returns a string describing the properties and ports of a MIDI device.
